entities.summary: Awsanite, a notable figure in the history of Yemen, associated with Ancient South Arabian Kingdoms (800 BCE–25 BCE). Preceded by Competing South Arabian States and Roman expedition under Aelius Gallus fails to conquer Arabia Felix (26–25 BC). Their legacy influenced Ma'rib Dam built — an engineering marvel irrigating 9,600 hectares and Queen of Sheba's legendary visit to King Solomon.
